title: Tarragona Amphitheatre
geometryBasis: Native protected-site way 77502859, several mapped stone terrace lines, and church-ruin way 1550945597. The city’s published 62.5 by 38.5 m arena dimensions center its ellipse within the curved podium remains.
sectionBasis: The city documents a 3.25 m original podium, terraces cut into rock on the landward flank, and vaulted seating elsewhere. Three original Public Domain Dedication photographs reveal how much survives, backed by the national LiDAR ground surface.
limitations: The present visible ruin is modeled. The building remains measured and interpreted at the scale of the surviving complex, with individual broken stones, stair breaks and excavated channel depths represented approximately.
The modern site paths, handrails, structural conservation barriers and nearby buildings are outside this model except for the main walking levels needed to read the ruin.
